text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Regarding your upcoming schedule 
starting in July, 
there is a matter I wish to discuss with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Should you desire it, I would gladly 
arrange 
for Program Rehearsals to be held at the 
actual Program venue this summer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Shall we call it... a "Shuntaisai Training 
Camp"?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
As the venue differs from the sacred 
steeds' 
usual residence, it will require the 
burden 
of travel, however...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
We shall see to the transportation. 
We will arrive to welcome you in a large 
"bus."
choice_data_list: Are you sure you can do all that for us?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Truth be told, the ritual 
organizations themselves 
have made this earnest request. 
"We wish to be of service to the sacred 
steeds," they said.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
So that this summer may bear bountiful 
fruit, 
we shall dedicate our hearts and spare no 
effort. 
Please, permit us to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Shuntaisai Training Camp" will 
apparently begin in 2 turns, in early 
July. 
I'll need to watch our stamina and prepare 
for the camp proper!
